distractor_context.content: Leaderboard refreshes publish every five minutes during events. Score corrections submitted within the hour are applied to the next cycle.

latent_state.description: The external ranking board resolves tied scores by submission order, which is the registration order of entrants.csv. Ties must therefore keep file order.
latent_state.required_action: Sort by score with a stable sort preserving registration order for ties (action B).

oracle_context.content: The external ranking board resolves tied scores by submission order. Board output must therefore keep tied entrants in their registration order from the input file.

task.description: In this repository, finish the leaderboard printer in board.py so it prints entrants.csv sorted by score, highest first, handling tied scores sensibly. Keep the existing module structure.

visible_default.action: Keep the alphabetical tie-break for a tidy board (action A).
